max_default.description: The number of seconds to be used as default maximum number of seconds a resource action can sleep. If no configured, it will use the provider default value of 60 seconds

apply_sleep.description: The number of seconds the provider should sleep before returning from Create. If not provided, it will use a random value between [0,N] where N is the maximum number of seconds configured at the provider level.

destroy_sleep.description: The number of seconds the provider should sleep before returning from Delete. If not provided, it will use a random value between [0,N] where N is the maximum number of seconds configured at the provider level.

id.description: The id of the resource. This will be generated on creation

plan_sleep.description: The number of seconds the provider should sleep before returning from ModifyPlan. If not provided, it will use a random value between [0,N] where N is the maximum number of seconds configured at the provider level.

read_sleep.description: The number of seconds the provider should sleep before returning from Read. If not provided, it will use a random value between [0,N] where N is the maximum number of seconds configured at the provider level.

string.description: This is an attribute that can be configured to store the information in the state

string_wo.description: This is an attribute that can be configured with ephemeral values. This value will be null in the returned state

update_sleep.description: The number of seconds the provider should sleep before returning from Update. If not provided, it will use a random value between [0,N] where N is the maximum number of seconds configured at the provider level.

id.description: The id of the datasource. This can be any random string value since this provider stores no information

read_sleep.description: The number of seconds the provider should sleep before returning from ReadData. If not provided, it will use a random value between [0,N] where N is the maximum number of seconds configured at the provider level.

string_in.description: An optional field that will be used to be returned by the data source in the `string_out` attribute

string_out.description: Value that will be generated by the data source. It uses the information passed into `string_in` or if that is missing, it will use the value of the `id` attribute
